{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(df.head())

# Check dtypes and nulls
print("\nDtypes:")
print(df.dtypes)

print("\nMissing values:")
print(df.isnull().sum())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("\nUnique values in customer_age:")
print(df['customer_age'].unique())

# Count sentinel values
sentinel_count = (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"\nNumber of -1 values in customer_age: {sentinel_count}")"}
